title: sehima spathiflora
intro: Sehima spathiflora, commonly known as the grass tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Sehima spathiflora include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative effects, making it useful in treating various ailments such as pain, diarrhea, and stomach ulcers. The bioactive constituents present in Sehima spathiflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
